q.en: "There isn't ___ time left." Which word fits?
q.bn: "There isn't ___ time left." কোন শব্দটা বসবে?

why.en: "Time" is uncountable, so it pairs with "much," not "many."

options.en: He gave me three advices about the interview.
options.bn: He gave me three advices about the interview.

options.en: He gave me some advice about the interview.
options.bn: He gave me some advice about the interview.

options.en: He gave me an advice about the interview.
options.bn: He gave me an advice about the interview.

options.en: He gave me advices about the interview.
options.bn: He gave me advices about the interview.

why.en: "Advice" is uncountable — it has no plural and never takes "a/an." To count it, say "a piece of advice."
why.bn: "Advice" uncountable — এর plural হয় না, "a/an"-ও বসে না। গুনতে চাইলে "a piece of advice" বলতে হয়।

q.en: Which of these is uncountable in English (no plural, no "a/an")?
q.bn: নিচের কোনটা English-এ uncountable (plural হয় না, "a/an" বসে না)?

why.en: "Furniture" is uncountable — you can't say "a furniture" or "furnitures." Use "a piece/item of furniture" to count it.
why.bn: "Furniture" uncountable — "a furniture" বা "furnitures" বলা যায় না। গুনতে "a piece/item of furniture" ব্যবহার করতে হয়।

q.en: "I have ___ friends here" (meaning it's fine — you have some, enough to be okay).
q.bn: "I have ___ friends here" (মানে ঠিক আছে — কিছু বন্ধু আছে, যথেষ্ট)।

why.en: "A few" sounds positive/neutral (some, enough). "Few" (no "a") sounds negative — almost none.
why.bn: "A few" positive/neutral শোনায় (কিছু আছে, যথেষ্ট)। "Few" ("a" ছাড়া) negative শোনায় — প্রায় নেই।

q.en: For an IELTS Writing Task 1 chart, which phrase is the most formal way to say "most"?
q.bn: IELTS Writing Task 1 chart-এ "most" বোঝানোর সবচেয়ে formal উপায় কোনটা?

why.en: "The majority of" is the formal, Task-1-appropriate way to express "most."
why.bn: "The majority of" হলো formal, Task-1-উপযোগী way "most" বোঝানোর।
